decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 10 August 2005, the erection of a roof extension, comprising a rear dormer measuring 5.258 metres wide, 2.29 metres high and 3 metres projection at top and a hip to gable conversion was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.  
Condition : 2 - Informative:

If you commence work on the single storey rear extension approved under 	00329/86/P1 before you have completed the roof extension you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the roof extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan 	secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is also likely to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension comprising rear dormer and alteration of hipped roof to gable end.
